hooks.command: deliver_guard=@GUARD@; [ -f "$deliver_guard" ] || exit 0; if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec uv run --python 3.13 --no-project --quiet "$deliver_guard" antigravity; fi; python3 -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 13))' 2>/dev/null || exit 0; exec python3 "$deliver_guard" antigravity
